chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir, from ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from Faḍālah, from al-Qāsim ibn Burayd, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
A man is shrouded in three garments, and a woman, if she is full-bodied, in five: a shift, a waist-wrapper, a head-cover, and two wrapping cloths.
ai.seo_question: How many burial shrouds are used for a man and a woman in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the number and types of burial shrouds used for men and women. It specifies that a man is shrouded in three garments, while a full-bodied woman is shrouded in five specific pieces.
